mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( user_id, item_id, quantity, order_price, shipping_fee, discount, total_price, order_date ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{itemId}, #{quantity}, #{orderPrice}, #{shippingFee}, #{discount}, #{totalPrice}, #{orderDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, i.item_name, s.shop_name, o.quantity, o.order_price, o.total_price, o.order_date FROM orders o INNER JOIN items i ON o.item_id = i.id INNER JOIN shops s ON i.shop_id = s.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY order_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(id) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) AS totalAmount FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId}
